title: Choose where to run, and keep a record
description: Compare the estimated emissions of each place an analysis could run, choose one, and record the choice as a non-transferable token.
intro: Before running an analysis, you can see how much CO2 the same work would produce at each place it could run. Choose one. You can then keep a record of that choice.
The record is a token that stays with you. It cannot be sold or passed on. It shows who chose, when, and what the options were at that moment. It is not a certified emission reduction.

work.heading: 1. The work
work.hint: Planning figures. The same run time is assumed everywhere, although real machines differ.

options.heading: 2. Where to run it
options.notComparableHint: Their power use has not been measured, so no emissions figure is given. They are not ranked, and they are never counted as zero.
options.difference: The highest option, {highest}, is estimated at {hg}. The difference is {d}.
options.differenceZero: This is the highest of the options compared.
options.caution: This is a difference between two estimates. It is not a reduction measured against what would otherwise have happened.

fee.heading: 3. How the fee is set (prototype)
fee.intro: Try rules that make low-emission locations cheaper. The money is PLAY, play money on a test network (Sepolia), with no value. In every case the provider receives its full list price. Only your share changes.
fee.loadError: Could not read from Sepolia. Please reload later.
fee.type3Hint: High-emission locations pay a surcharge, which goes into a pool. Low-emission locations get a discount paid from that pool. No outside money; when the pool is empty there is no discount.
fee.type4Hint: A funder (a research council, for example) deposits money. When you choose a low-emission location, part of the fee is paid from it.
fee.totals: {n} payments so far. Surcharges {in}, discounts {out}, subsidies {sub}.
fee.draft: These settings differ from scheme #{id} on Sepolia. The amounts below are an on-screen estimate. A real payment uses the settings of #{id}.
fee.createScheme: Create my own scheme with these settings
fee.createHint: If you create a scheme, you run it: you can change its settings and deposit money into it.
fee.short: The pool is short, so the discount is {v} (the rule asks for {w}).
fee.notPriced: No price is registered, so this prototype cannot take payment here.
fee.payHint: The payment also stores the fingerprint of the record in step 4.
fee.payNotPriced: The chosen location has no registered price. Please choose another.
fee.connect: Connect a wallet to pay or deposit.
fee.busy: Waiting for the wallet and the network…
fee.paid: Stored in the ledger as payment #{id}.
fee.ledgerHint: Every payment is on Sepolia. Anyone can check when, for whom, and for which analysis a subsidy was paid.
fee.caution: Bands come from the portal's estimate of emissions per hour, not from measurement. A discount or subsidy is not proof that emissions were reduced.
fee.contract: Contract {address} on Sepolia. It holds the play money PLAY and the fee rules. The providers' receiving addresses are made-up addresses for this prototype.
fee.helpGco2e: gCO2e is grams of CO2 equivalent. Gases other than CO2, such as methane, are converted to CO2 by their warming effect and added up. Here it is an estimate of the emissions from the electricity used to run a computer at that place for one hour.
fee.helpPool: The pool is the saved-up money that pays for discounts. It is filled by the surcharges paid at high-emission places. No outside money goes in. When it is empty, there is no discount.
fee.helpDeposit: The deposit balance is what is left of the money a funder deposited. Each subsidy is paid from it, so it goes down with every payment.
fee.jobBanner: Paying for compute job {id}. The ledger will keep the SHA-256 of this job ID, so anyone with the ID can find the payment.
fee.helpJob: The ledger stores only a fingerprint (SHA-256) of the job ID, not the ID itself.

gate.title: Who may receive the subsidy
gate.hint: Choose, per scheme, how eligibility for the type 4 subsidy is checked. Surcharge and discount (type 3) are open to everyone in every case.
gate.help: Open: anyone gets the subsidy. List: only wallets the operator added by hand. Voucher: only a wallet holding a short-lived signed voucher from the issuer. Only the wallet address is ever written to the ledger, never a name.
name: Open: everyone
List: wallets the operator registered
Voucher: a signed, short-lived voucher
gate.needWallet: Connect a wallet to see whether you are eligible.
gate.eligible: You are eligible for the subsidy in this scheme.
gate.notListed: This wallet is not on the list, so no subsidy is paid. Surcharge and discount still apply.
gate.needVoucher: Paste a valid voucher below to receive the subsidy. Without it no subsidy is paid.
gate.voucherHint: Only the shape is checked on this page. The contract checks the signature when you pay, and rejects an invalid or expired voucher.

record.heading: 4. Keep a record
record.what: The record lists every option, its figures and their sources. Download it and keep it with your project files. Its fingerprint (SHA-256) goes on the test network, so anyone can later check the file has not changed.
record.connect: Connect a wallet to record this choice on Sepolia (the test network; no real money).
record.busy: Waiting for the wallet and the network…
record.downloadFirst: Download the record first. Only its fingerprint goes on chain; the file itself is kept by you.

mine.heading: 5. Records
mine.checkHint: Choose a downloaded record. Its fingerprint is compared with the tokens shown above.
mine.match: This file matches token #{id}. It has not changed since it was recorded.
mine.noMatch: This file does not match any of the tokens above.

footnote: Contract {address} on Sepolia. It stores who recorded what and when, and refuses transfers. It does not check the figures.
